messages:
mina: Preparing a config-only push for tonight's 23:15 PT window. Changes: reduce tinybatch.window, tweak routing.weights to favor newer replicas, and lower idle timeout for background tenants. config id cfg-7532468000. Canary plan: 7% for 12m, then gradual 20% if no regressions.

deploy-bot: Scheduled by mina — canary 7% for 12m across us-west and eu-west. Rollout id cfg-7532468000. Observability link: https://dash/reports/cfg-7532468000

carlos: Acknowledged. I'll run the quick smoke: 25 synthetics/region, check 5xx and 99p. Alert triggers: 5xx > 0.3% OR 99p > 700ms -> pause.

maya: We should pin the model to v1.4-hotfix to avoid cache layout drift. Also note: sticky routing for enterprise tenants enabled in config.

mina: Applied model.pin=v1.4-hotfix, routing.sticky=enterprise, tinybatch.window 45ms -> 28ms, timeout.background 15s -> 10s.

deploy-bot: Canary started (7%). Commands: `/deploybot pause cfg-7532468000` or `/deploybot rollback cfg-7532468000`. Live logs: `kubectl -n inference logs -f deploy/cfg-7532468000`

ops-bot: Metric alert: eu-west 99p jumped to ~930ms at +5m. KV-cache miss ratio increased for tenant-eu-finance.

carlos: I'm throttling canary to 2% and pausing rollforward. Log shows `WARN kvcache: seed_miss=0.31 tenant=tenant-eu-finance region=eu-west`.

maya: Suggest partial rollback of routing.weights and tinybatch.window only; keep model pin. Proposed: `/deploybot rollback cfg-7532468000 --targets routing,tinybatch --reason "eu kv miss spike"`

mina: Running partial rollback now. Notifying support about a brief latency blip for EU enterprise tenants and scheduling targeted kv prewarm.

deploy-bot: Partial rollback completed at 7532468045. Canary paused. Rollback summary: routing.weights reverted, tinybatch.window restored to 45ms. model.pin retained (v1.4-hotfix). Next steps: run kv prewarm script, validate 99p over 10m, then retry canary with slower ramp.
